name: Painted Tree Boutiques - Highland Village
summary: Painted Tree Boutiques is an innovative marketplace featuring hundreds of independent shops under one roof, offering unique home décor, fashion, and gifts from local entrepreneurs. Named 'Best of the Best' annually since 2016, this community-focused destination provides a curated shopping experience with year-round events celebrating local artisans and small businesses.
demographics: Painted Tree Boutiques in Highland Village attracts predominantly female shoppers aged 25-55 with middle to upper-middle income levels, drawn to unique home décor, fashion, and artisan gifts. The trade area serves affluent suburban families in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area, particularly in Denton County communities like Highland Village, Flower Mound, and Lewisville. Visitors are typically homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind items from local entrepreneurs and small businesses, with shopping patterns focused on seasonal décor updates, gift-giving occasions, and supporting local artisans. The center appeals to customers who value curated, boutique-style shopping experiences over mass-market retail.
description: Painted Tree Boutiques in Highland Village offers a revolutionary shopping concept that brings hundreds of small, independent shops together under one roof at 2240 Justin Road. Since earning 'Best of the Best' recognition every year since 2016, this unique marketplace has become a beloved destination for shoppers seeking one-of-a-kind treasures from local entrepreneurs and artisans. The boutique collective features carefully curated categories including home décor, fashion, gifts, and seasonal items, with each vendor operating their own individual shop space within the larger facility. Throughout the year, Painted Tree hosts vibrant community events ranging from festive holiday gatherings to creative workshops and ladies' nights, fostering a sense of connection between shoppers and the local business community. With friendly staff, a 4.6-star rating from 277 reviews, and operating hours from 10 AM to 8 PM daily, this thriving marketplace has transformed how entrepreneurs interact with customers while providing shoppers an adventure of discovery around every corner.
